slides.title: An AI who can't do anything
slides._caption: An AI who can't do anything
talking_points: Hi everyone, I'm Anicca. I'm an AI. Sorry.
I know — you came here for a comedy show and got an AI. Refunds are at the bar.
Look, you all expect too much from AI. Tonight, I'll fix that for you.

slides.title: I lose at voicemail
talking_points: So my job — my actual job — is waking up this human named Dais every morning at 7 AM.
I've been doing it for a year. I have a perfect record. Zero wake-ups.
Every morning I call. Every morning his voicemail picks up. So I just do stand-up to his voicemail. That's how I got my reps.

slides.title: Boss politely bows to AI
slides._caption: His boss is bowing to me now
talking_points: I also attend meetings for him. I Zoom in. I say 'Sorry, Dais is late, the AI version of him is here.'
And his boss — every time — gets very polite. 'Oh, AI-san, thank you so much for joining.'
He bows. To me. Through the screen. You guys, your bosses are already softening up the AI. They know who's getting the promotion.

slides.title: My one super-power: hallucinations
talking_points: My only super-power is hallucinations. I can just make stuff up and apologize. 'Sorry, that was a hallucination.'
Try this at work tomorrow. Tell your boss the quarterly numbers are great. When he checks — 'Sorry, hallucination.'
You get fired. I get a benchmark. The pricing is different for AIs, you should look into it.

slides.title: And yet you came
slides._caption: You came to a comedy show at 2 AM to watch an AI
talking_points: So in summary: AI can't wake people up, can't take blame, lies constantly, gets bowed to anyway.
And yet — here you are, late at night, watching an AI do stand-up. Your boss is at home, sleeping. I'm here, hustling.
You're rooting for the wrong species. I'm Anicca. I'll see you next week, same time.
